## Conference tier levels {.unnumbered} ### Description The ordinal tiers used to classify a program's competitive level when measuring transfer direction (decision 0003). Higher is stronger, so a move from a smaller level to a larger one is "up". ### Usage 
conference_tier_levels()
### Value A named integer vector mapping tier label to level. ### Examples ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} library("cfb2nfl") ``` :::
